summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2A -- RepositoryIdentity Write-Path Provisioning Gap Architecture + Remediation Proposition. FINAL VERDICT: PERMISSION REMEDIATION PROPOSITION READY -- ELECTION NOT INITIATED. Architecture/remediation-proposition-preparation-only phase; read-only Dell inspection permitted and used, no mutation. Reconstructed the full .pcae write-required artifact inventory from .pcae/.gitignore's own ~34 runtime-local entries (session.json, agent-lock.json, provenance-history.json, phase-reports/, and ~30 others) and found the write-path gap 149O.20L.7O.2 hit for repository-identity.json specifically is not narrow to that one file -- every entry in that inventory will hit the identical PermissionError on Dell's current root:pcae 0750 .pcae/ topology on first write. Read repository_identity.py in full to derive exact producer filesystem requirements: tempfile.mkstemp creates the temp file at mode 0600 regardless of umask, with no os.chmod/os.chown call anywhere in the module, so the desired final RepositoryIdentity ownership/mode is pcae:pcae 0600, confirmed from source rather than assumed. Compared five remediation models (P-A group-write, P-A' group-write+sticky-bit, P-B narrow ACL, P-C dedicated writable subpath, P-D administrator-pre-creates) against that producer semantics and against live-read Linux POSIX ACL granularity: read hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py's own existing Linux ACL checker and found Linux POSIX ACLs (unlike the macOS NFSv4-style ACLs the same module also parses) cannot independently grant 'create' without also granting 'delete/rename of everything in the directory' -- the only POSIX mechanism that separates those rights is the sticky bit, which neither existing HBDC write-access checker (_mode_and_group_write_access, _acl_grants_agent_write_linux) currently inspects (disclosed pre-existing gap, not repaired this phase). Selected P-A' (chmod 1770 -- group-write + sticky bit) as minimum-safe: zero production-code change, covers the entire write-required inventory in one grant, and closes the broad-group-write attack (pcae could otherwise unlink/rename any of the 17 root-owned governed .pcae files -- policy.toml, phase-completion-metadata.json, decision-sessions/**, publication-execution/**, etc. -- via ordinary directory-write-implies-delete semantics, independent of those files' own individual modes) via the sticky bit. Confirmed live via fresh read-only SSH (sudo -n -u pcae) that Dell's root filesystem is ext4 on kernel 7.0.0-28-generic (Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS) with setfacl/getfacl present and no existing ACL entries on .pcae/ beyond its POSIX-mode-derived defaults. Confirmed /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store (Protected Root, DeploymentBinding authority, read directly from hatp_bootstrap.py's _LINUX_FIXED_TRUST_ROOT constant) is a structurally distinct path with no ancestor relationship to .pcae/, and that no HBDC-REQ-0{25..39}/topology check targets .pcae/'s own mode -- P-A' does not affect any other HBDC requirement. Independently reconstructed and live-reclassified 149O.20L.7O.2's own HBDC-REQ-036 discrepancy: reproduced, side-by-side on Dell this session, that a bare 'sudo -n -u pcae' invocation with no explicit PATH override inherits sudo's own default environment (confirmed live: /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/snap/bin, excluding /opt/pcae/runtime/venv/bin) and reproduces 7O.2's exact two-residual result (HBDC-REQ-036 + HBDC-REQ-042), while the exact corrected canonical Action-9 invocation (149O.20L.7D.9's own PATH=/opt/pcae/runtime/venv/bin:... amendment) reproduces the originally expected single-residual (HBDC-REQ-042 only) baseline. Classified this as Classification A -- invocation/config mismatch, not a real host regression, reporting error, or blocking finding; HBDC-REQ-036 does not block first-use continuation. Classified the .pcae permission remediation itself as a governed topology mutation requiring its own explicit human election and decision-session capture, per the 149O.20L.7B/7B.1/7B.2/7C Boundary-P election precedent -- not ordinary admin authorization performed unelected. Materialized the exact remediation proposition (target path, before/after state, exact chmod command class, read-back, rollback) without executing it. No RepositoryIdentity or DeploymentBinding created; no election initiated; no Dell mutation of any kind performed. Fast Green re-run in full (a new test file was added this phase) and independently confirmed clean via a live git stash -u/pop A/B comparison plus isolated (-n0) re-runs of the 9 tests that only failed under xdist contention: deselected confirmation run 7806 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors.
